meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 它让 Claude 检查或设置 claude-mem 的云端同步：查同步状态（设备 ID、待同步条数、上次同步时间、Hub 是否可达），或把 cmem.ai → Connect 给的三个连接值写进本地设置、重启 worker 并验证。
howto.when: 当你说“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“sync status”等，或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到自己的 cmem.ai 账号时接管。

say.note: 会查询 worker 并报告状态

say.text: 帮我设置 cmem.ai 云同步
say.note: 会向你索要三个连接值

say.text: 云同步连不上，帮我查一下错误
say.note: 会报告 hub.error 或 lastError

howto.what_en: It lets Claude check or set up claude-mem cloud sync: read status (device id, pending counts, last flush, Hub reachability) or write the three cmem.ai → Connect values into local settings, restart the worker, and verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “set up cloud sync”, “sync my memories”, “sync status”, etc., or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Queries the worker and reports status

say_en.text: Set up cmem.ai cloud sync for me
say_en.note: Asks you for the three connection values

say_en.text: My cloud sync won't connect—check the error
